title: Engineering Problem
text: Engineering Problem. On first look these measuring spoons are a cooks dream come true. Everything included to make it easy for anyone who is math challenged. For instance a 2 tsp. measure. LOL.  Everyone needs one of those. (Ahem).. I digress. These are very heavy. Nicely made. The engineering problem being that the clip that is supposed to hold all this happiness together is a crappy piece of bent up metal that doesn't even begin to stay closed.  Could have been a big win. Now it's just a waste of space. I like the included leveler though. Very handy.

product_metadata.title: 2lbDepot Copper Measuring Spoons for Baking/Cooking, Set of 7 Includes Bonus Leveler, Premium Kitchen use Stainless Steel, Metal, Rust Proof, Narrow Design fits into Spice Jars
features: Comes with 6 measuring spoons, including: 1 tablespoon tbsp (15ml), 1 teaspoon tsp (5ml), 3/4 teaspoon (3.75ml) , 1/2 teaspoon (2.5ml), 1/4 teaspoon (1.25ml) , 1/8 teaspoon (.6ml) and as an added bonus our unique leveler.
Designed to last a lifetime. Made from heavy duty, rust proof 18/8 stainless steel and have USA metric (ml) measurement markings engraved directly into the measuring spoons, they’ll never wear off.
Unlike round measuring spoons, our narrow design and 4" long handles fit easily into spice jars or tins and can be used by chefs and bakers in commercial and residential kitchens.

Our Copper measuring spoons accurately measure liquid and dry ingredients like spices, water, coffee, tea, medicine, flour, supplements, protein powder, salt, pepper, honey etc. and gives a premium feel

Our high quality, rust proof 18/8 Copperplated stainless steel ring lets you quickly separate measuring spoons for easy use and dishwasher safe cleaning. Super compact, stores easily in any kitchen drawer.
